method: Docker chromium; open the widget panel by clicking the greeting preview, then read the messenger iframe rect.
conclusion: At the SAME 1440px viewport the mobile UA gets a fullscreen panel and the desktop UA the 538px sidebar. The live widget picks its variant by device detection (UA), not by CSS width; a static served page has no UA signal, so the mimic keys the mobile variant on the widget runtime's own 767px breakpoint instead.
